overall: Executive sessions on tax exemption and abatement applications were proper under Purpose 7, but the Board violated the Law on executive session procedure, notice specificity and timing, and minutes; immediate and future compliance ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint that meeting notices failed to say an executive session would occur for tax exemption and abatement topics.
allegations.key_passage: These meeting notices therefore fell short of the requirement that the Board state "all subjects that may be revealed without compromising the purpose for which the executive session" will be called.

allegations.summary: Whether discussing tax exemption and abatement applications in executive session was a permissible purpose.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Board's discussions of tax exemption and tax abatement applications were appropriate for executive session under Purpose 7.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the Board did not follow required steps to enter executive session: purpose citation, roll call, and announcing whether it would reconvene.
Complaint that the Board failed to timely post notice for a meeting.
allegations.key_passage: In addition, the Board inadvertently failed to timely post notice for three of its meetings.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the November 2012 minutes lacked sufficient detail on discussions and votes on tax exemption and abatement applications.
allegations.key_passage: the November 2012 meeting minutes were not sufficient because they failed to include any details about the discussion and votes on tax exemption and abatement applications.

allegations.summary: Complaint that executive session minutes did not list documents and exhibits used at the meetings.
allegations.key_passage: all of the executive session minutes should have contained "a list of documents and other exhibits used at the meeting," to the extent that a specific application and supporting documents were discussed by the body during a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint that 2012 meeting notices did not include the location of each meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review this allegation because our Office will not conduct broad audits of public bodies based on generalized allegations.

allegations.summary: Complaint about executive session procedures at the January 10, 2013 meeting, filed outside the 30-day window.
allegations.key_passage: Since the alleged violation could have been reasonably discovered at the time of the meeting, we find that this allegation is untimely.

remedy: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
